name: Animal Skins
text: Once per day, when you Change Shape, you can instead gain the effects of Animal Form, heightened to half your level rounded up, for 1 minute or until you shift back, whichever comes first.

name: Animal Speaker
text: Reptiles might still be your favorites, but that doesn't mean they're the only animals with whom you converse. You can speak to all animals, not just animals that are reptiles. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Make an Impression on animals (which usually uses the Diplomacy skill).

name: Anomalous Provenance
text: You were born Gap-touched, have long since acclimated to your strange affliction, and can wield it more effectively than most of your peers. When you Step, you can flicker in and out of reality, causing your Step to gain the teleportation trait and allowing you to Step into Difficult Terrain.

name: Anti-Theist Resistance
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You fail or critically fail a saving throw against a divine spell or effect. Your resistance to the god Kadrical has manifested in the form of great resilience against divine influence. You reroll the triggering saving throw and use the second result.

name: Anticipate Danger
text: Frequency: once per 10 minutes Trigger: A creature attacks you while you're to them, you share a language with that creature, and that creature is within range of your limited telepathy. The very thoughts of your enemies give them away. The triggering attack roll targets your Perception DC instead of your AC. Though this allows you to avoid taking penalties to your AC, it doesn't remove any conditions or other effects causing such penalties. For example, an enemy with sneak attack would still deal extra damage to you for being off-guard.

name: Antipodal Duality
text: While most dragons can only focus their magic towards combat techniques or advanced spellcasting, not both, the unique way you've progressed after the lux aeterna ritual makes you especially suited to learn it all. You gain whichever of Draconic Ravager Dedication or Dragon Mage Dedication you didn't already have, even if you normally couldn't take another dedication feat until you take more feats from the Draconic Ravager or Dragon Mage archetype.

name: Apocalypse Burst
text: You vent the contents of your stomach while spinning in place, unleashing a cloud of your internal gases in a . This functions as Fire Breath, except that the damage dice are d10s instead of d4s. Creatures that fail their Reflex saves against this effect are also Dazzled for 1 round. You can't use Fire Breath for 1 minute.

name: Appraising Sight
text: Your sight establishes the inner nature of objects around you, making it easier to appraise them. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to Recall Knowledge about an item or Identify Magic on a magic item. You can cast Object Reading as an innate occult spell once per day.

name: Arboreal Acrobat
text: While vulkarisu are naturally good climbers, you're exceptional, and can ascend and descend vertical surfaces without a second thought. You become trained in Athletics. If you would automatically become trained in Athletics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the skill feat, and you reduce the number of free hands required to Climb by one.

name: Arcane Adept
text: Your intense magical studies have taught you how to watch out for signs of magic even when looking for other things. When you're Searching, you also gain the benefits of the Detect Magic exploration activity unless you choose not to.

name: Arcane Consumption
text: Your blood consumes arcane magic. Whenever you successfully save against a foe's harmful spell or magical effect, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to the spell's rank or equal to the level if the magical effect isn't a spell (double the number of temporary Hit Points you gain if the spell or trait is arcane). You gain these temporary Hit Points before the effect is resolved, and they last until the end of your next turn.

name: Arcane Recall
text: Frequency once per day Your training has enhanced your memory for magic, and spells linger in your mind. You can cast one spell you've already cast today without expending a spell slot.

name: Arcane Sense
text: Your study of magic has attuned your mind to detect its presence. You can cast detect magic as an arcane innate cantrip, heightened to a level equal to half your level rounded up.

name: Arctic Bite
text: The freezing power of your bite becomes irresistible. The cold damage dealt by your jaws Strike increases to 2d6[untyped] damage and ignores an amount of the target's cold resistance equal to your level. A creature's immunities are unaffected.

name: Area Denial Turret
text: You can spend 2 actions to Area Fire your turret. When you do, your turret gains the area (cone) or area (line) trait — your choice — and its range is halved.

name: Armor Ace
text: You've learned through trial and painful error how to make the most out of your armor, deflecting damage from explosions and similar effects. When donning armor, you can grant it the bulwark trait until you remove it. When you're wearing armor that already has the bulwark trait, increase the modifier to Reflex saves to avoid damaging effects granted by that armor to +4, rather than +3.

name: Armor Proficiency
text: You become trained in light armor. If you already were trained in light armor, you gain training in medium armor. If you were trained in both, you become trained in heavy armor. If you are at least 13th level, you become an expert in this armor type. Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time, you become trained in the next type of armor, as detailed above.

name: Armored Advance
text: Your armor becomes a weapon as you charge. When you Stride at least 10 feet and make a melee Strike, if you hit, the target is pushed 5 feet and knocked prone (Fortitude DC = your class DC to avoid prone).

name: Armored Shell
text: You've grown an armored copi exoskeleton—far sturdier than most copaxi exoskeletons—to protect the rest of your body from harm. Your exoskeleton grants a +3 item bonus to AC, has a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of –2, and a Strength threshold of +3, and has the comfort and exposed traits. You're trained in your exoskeleton. You can wear a Flight Suit, but you can't wear other armor. You can't install armor upgrades or etch armor runes onto your exoskeleton.

name: Armpit Pocket
text: You are adept at carrying objects in your armpit pockets. You can store up to four objects of negligible or light Bulk in your pockets. Stored objects are protected from environmental damage, including water. You can stow or remove an object as an Interact action, or drop all stored objects to the ground as a free action. When you become Unconscious, all stored objects are dropped.

name: Art is Dead
text: You've studied music and color theory; you understand the necessary function of art while removing any ambiguous subtext, metaphor, and even the very soul that makes it art. You can use Society in place of Performance when you use the [[/act perform skill=society]] action and Earn Income downtime activity. You can Create Forgery to replicate digital works of art (such as pictures, movies, and songs).

name: Ascended Stability
text: Trigger You would cycle or become unattuned. You briefly enter a meditative state in which you re‑center yourself and remember the ever-shifting balance between the violent extremes of the cycle. You don't become unattuned or cycle, and you remain in your current attunement state.

name: Ascended Stability
text:
Trigger You would cycle or become unattuned.

You briefly enter a meditative state in which you re-center yourself and remember the ever-shifting balance between the violent extremes of the cycle. You don't become unattuned or cycle, and you remain in your current attunement state.

name: Ascending Necrovite
text: You've reached the pinnacle of necrovite training available to living creatures. You've crafted an electroencephalon, a type of high-tech soul cage designed to preserve your existence, and you've begun your mystical preparations for your final transition into undeath. You gain void healing and immunity to death effects, disease, and poison. You gain resistance 5 to cold and physical damage. When you die, your soul immediately transfers to your electroencephalon.

name: Aspiring Necrovite
text: You don't plan to die—instead, you're going to exist forever as a necrovite. You live by the Song of Silence and have spent time investigating undead organizations and studying the processes required to make the final transition into undeath. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on checks to Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo about undead creatures, the Corpse Fleet, and Eox. You also learn the Necril language.

name: Assistant Regional Manager
text: Frequency: once per hour You've been promoted to assist a mysterious supervisor who communicates via suspiciously well-timed text messages, infosphere newsreels, or even conveniently placed graffiti that quickly conveys exactly what you need to know to get the job done. When you , your benefactor sends you a clue that allows you to make your check with Society instead of any other skill, as well as roll twice and use the better result. If you Recall Knowledge using Business Lore, Corporate Lore, or Society, reduce the frequency of Assistant Regional Manager to once per 10 minutes.

name: Assistive Goo Gush
text: Frequency one every 10 minutes Your sticky resin flows into your wounds or the wounds of an adjacent creature currently taking persistent damage, helping to repair cellular damage. For the next minute, reduce the DC of any flat check the target rolls to recover from persistent damage as though it were being assisted. The target immediately rolls a flat check to see if it recovers from each ongoing source of persistent damage.

name: Assistive Shove
text: Trigger An adjacent ally who is at least one size smaller than you would be hit by a Strike. You use your size and leverage to quickly move an ally out of harm's way. Attempt an Athletics check to Shove the ally targeted by the triggering Strike. If your ally is willing, treat the result as one degree of success higher. On a success, in addition to its normal effects, the Shoved ally also gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their AC against the triggering Strike.

name: Assurance
text: Choose a skill you are trained in. Even in the worst circumstances, you can perform the basics of that skill reliably. You can forgo rolling the chosen skill to instead receive a result of 10 + your proficiency bonus.

name: Assurance (Recall Knowledge)
text: Even in adverse conditions, you can perform basic tasks. For Recall Knowledge checks, you can forgo rolling and instead take a result equal to 10 plus your proficiency bonus.

name: Astral Eyes
text: You can imbue your eyes with thoughtforms from the Astral Plane, allowing you to temporarily see the invisible. Once per hour, you can cast See Invisibility as an innate occult spell, though it only lasts 1 minute instead of 10 minutes. Once per day, when you cast see invisibility in this way, it has its full 10-minute duration.

name: Astral Sight
text: Your astral eyes are always active. You gain the effects of See Invisibility at all times.

name: Astrophysicist
text: You have an innate knowledge of suns, stars, and stellar forces. You become trained in Nature. If you would automatically become trained in Nature (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the Additional Lore feat for Physical Science Lore and one other space-related lore of your choice, such as Astrophysics Lore, Astronomy Lore, Star Lore, or Sun Lore.

name: Astrowanderer
text: You've traveled out into the stars and adapted to the void of space, allowing you to survive in lifeless conditions and operate more effectively in zero-gravity environments. You can breathe in a vacuum without environmental protection and ignore the Clumsy condition imposed by being Untethered in zero-g.

name: At Home In My Body
text: You eschew physical augmentations beyond what's necessary, avoiding superfluous enhancements on your body. During your daily preparations, choose a skill that you're at least trained in. Until your next daily preparations, you gain the feat for that skill.

name: Atmospheric Flight
text: You can manifest your energy wings while within an atmosphere for a short time. Your energy wings manifest, granting you a fly Speed equal to your land Speed plus 10 feet for 10 minutes. You can end this duration early as a single action.

name: Attuned Blow
text: You can use your manifestations immediately upon attuning yourself. When you Attune as a single action, you can make a Strike with your solar flare or solar weapon as a free action.

name: Attuned Blow
text: You can use your manifestations immediately upon attuning yourself. When you Attune as a single action, you can make a Strike with your solar flare or solar weapon as a free action.

name: Attuned Wards
text: You extend your control of stellar forces to punish your foes. Creatures that hit you with an attack suffer consequences based on your attunement. Graviton-Attuned The creature is Clumsy 1 and Off-Guard for 1 round. This increases to Clumsy 2 if this is the second time it hit you this turn. Photon-Attuned The creature takes persistent fire damage equal to half your level.

name: Attuned Wards
text:
You extend your control of stellar forces to punish your foes. Creatures that hit you with an attack suffer consequences based on your attunement.

Graviton-Attuned The creature is Clumsy 1 and for 1 round. This increases to Clumsy 2 if this is the second time it hit you this turn.

Photon-Attuned The creature takes persistent fire damage equal to half your level.

name: Augmented Adaptation
text: You've adapted your own body to suit your needs. The total number of augmentations you can install is increased by two.

name: Augmented Body
text: You implant one augmentation with an item level equal to your character level or lower. This augmentation doesn't count against your total implant limit. The first time you take this feat, the augmentation you receive is free as long as its item level is 1 or lower. You can upgrade this augmentation by swapping it out with another augmentation when you gain a level or by spending downtime replacing the augmentation as though changing out a feat. When you swap out the augmentation, you must pay the difference between the original and new augmentation each time you upgrade. Special You can select this feat multiple times, choosing a different augmentation each time. Retraining this feat requires paying the cost of the original augmentation.

name: Augmented Shell
text: Your exoskeleton shell has further merged with your body, granting you more bodily space for enhancements. Increase the number of augmentations you can have implanted by 2.

name: Aurum Authority
text: Your golden blood grants you access to powerful magic that lets you better lead and threaten those around you. You gain Command and Fear as 1st-rank arcane innate spells. You can cast each of these arcane innate spells once per day.

name: Auto Loop
text: At the start of each enemy's turn, you gain an additional reaction that you can use on that turn for a mechanic reaction.

name: Auto Spellshape
text: Altering your spells takes no longer than casting them normally. You can use spellshape actions as free actions.

name: Auto-Target
text: Reaction (Trigger: a creature within 30 feet of your drone or turret uses a move action or leaves a square during a move action). Your drone or turret makes a ranged Strike against it; this Strike doesn't count toward, and isn't affected by, your multiple attack penalty.

name: Automatic Knowledge
text: You know basic facts off the top of your head. Choose a skill you're an expert in that has the Recall Knowledge action and for which you have the Assurance feat. You can use the Recall Knowledge action with that skill as a free action once per round. If you do, you must use Assurance on the skill check. Special You can select this feat multiple times, choosing a different skill each time. You can use Automatic Knowledge with any skills you have chosen, but you can still use Automatic Knowledge only once per round.

name: Avid Traveler
text: You spend more time gallivanting across the galaxy than you do at home. You become trained in Society. If you would automatically become trained in Society (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the Multilingual skill feat.

name: Aw, Nuts!
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You fail a skill check. Requirements You're not in a combat encounter. You're always prepared to catch yourself mid-failure before it cascades into a complete disaster, shrugging off a potential mistake as merely bad luck and pushing forward without letting it get you down. Reroll the triggering skill check and use the better result.

name: Back to Back Bond
text: You and your partner are so in tune with each other that you can move past each other with ease on the battlefield. You can end your movement sharing the same space as your bonded partner and they can do the same, even if you're the same size. As long as you're in the same square, you and your bonded partner can't be flanked by creatures of your level or lower.

name: Back to Your Roots
text: Despite your unusual heritage, you've used the lux aeterna ritual to build up a strong mystical connection to your other dragon heritage as well. You gain the full benefits of the dragon heritage you chose at 1st level to determine the effect of your Breath Weapon and similar feats. This not only grants you the heritage's listed benefits but also allows you to take feats and other character options that require you to be a member of that heritage.

name: Backup Spell
text: [one-action] to [three-actions] (once per hour) You regain one expended spell slot at least 2 ranks lower than your highest and that takes 1-3 actions to cast, then immediately cast a cached spell using that slot. Action cost equals the spell cast. Afterward you're stupefied 3 and your tech gear is glitching 3 until the end of your next turn.

name: Balancing Tail
text: You've developed a healthy appreciation for your prehensile tail. It's hard to imagine life without it—you'd probably fall over all the time. Luckily, yours is there to help keep your balance, even in the trickiest situations. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to [[/act balance]] and a +1 circumstance bonus to your Reflex DC against attempts to [[/act trip]] you. As long as your tail isn't holding an item, you aren't Off-Guard while on a narrow surface or uneven ground.

name: Baleful Gaze
text:
Frequency once per minute
You have an ominous presence that unnerves the living. You have learned to harness this sinister aura to your own advantage and can scare your foes with a focused glance. Focus your ill intent at one living creature within 30 feet. The target must succeed at a save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC, or become Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure) and Stupefied 1 as long as it's frightened. Once you've used Baleful Gaze against a creature, it's temporarily immune for 24 hours.

name: Baleful Presence
text: You've learned to unleash the anger and malice you've built up over the course of your life and restless undeath against multiple foes at once, creating a potent effect around yourself. You can choose to use Baleful Gaze as a 2-action activity, rather than 1. When you do, Baleful Gaze gains the divine trait, loses the visual trait, and affects each living creature in a , rather than a single living creature.

name: Banishing Breath
text: Infused with the power of Heaven your breath can banish summoned creatures with ease. As long as you are on your home plane, or in one of your planar infusions from the Planar Infusion feat, when a summoned creature critically fails its save against your Dragon Breath, the summoning effect ends and the summoned creature shimmers and disappears.

name: Barathu Lore
text: From your upbringing, you've learned the ways of your people while also seeking to expand your own mind in the fields of creation. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Crafting and Medicine. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the general feat for Barathu Lore.

name: Bargain Hunter
text: You always seek out the best deal. When you spend downtime shopping you can usually find items at a slight discount, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Barter.

name: Barricade
text: You hastily create a barricade using nearby items, junk, or debris. The barricade provides lesser cover for you and one other ally, though you can Take Cover to increase this benefit to standard cover. The barricade is flimsy and falls apart at the end of your next turn.

name: Basic Distortion
text: Your disruptive powers grow. You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level witchwarper feat.

name: Basic Epiphany
text: You gain your connection's initial epiphany spell. If you don't already have one, you also gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, which you can Refocus by reflecting on your connection.

name: Basic Expertise
text: Your social repertoire broadens. You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level envoy feat of your choice.

name: Basic Flight
text: Frequency once per minute You Fly. If you don't have a fly Speed, you gain a fly Speed equal to your ancestry's Flight Specialist entry for this action. If you aren't on solid ground at the end of this movement, you fall.

name: Basic Flight
text: Frequency once per minute You Fly. If you don't have a fly Speed, you gain a fly Speed equal to your ancestry's Flight Specialist entry for this action. If you aren't on solid ground at the end of this movement, you fall.

name: Basic Gunner
text: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level operative feat.

name: Basic Insectile Flight
text: Some shirrens are born with wings, but others grow them later. You evolve a pair of insectile wings that grant you a fly Speed of 20 feet. In addition, when you fall, you take no falling damage. Special If you're a winged shirren, you either grow a second set of wings or your existing wings morph into a stronger set of wings, increasing your fly Speed to 25 feet.

name: Basic Leadership
text: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level envoy feat of your choice.

name: Basic Maneuver
text: Your battlefield training deepens. You gain one 1st- or 2nd-level soldier class feat of your choice.

name: Basic Mystic Spellcasting
text: You gain the Basic Spellcasting benefits. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the mystic archetype, add a spell of the appropriate spell rank to your repertoire: a common spell of your connection's tradition, or one of your connection's granted spells.

name: Basic Mysticism
text: Your bond with the cosmos deepens. You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level mystic feat of your choice.

name: Basic Operative Trick
text: You pick up another trade trick. You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level operative feat of your choice.

name: Basic Paradigm Shift
text: You learn to nudge probability further. You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level witchwarper feat of your choice.

name: Basic Quantum Field
text: Your quantum field gains the effect of your chosen paradox.

name: Basic Solar Manifestation
text: Your connection to the cosmos sharpens. You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level solarian feat of your choice.

name: Basic Soldier Training
text: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level soldier feat.

name: Basic Spell Hacking
text: Your fusion of code and spellcraft advances. You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level technomancer feat of your choice.

name: Basic Stellar Attunement
text: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level solarian feat.

name: Basic Tinkering
text: Your aptitude with gadgets grows. You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level mechanic feat of your choice.

name: Basic Warp Spell
text: You gain your paradox's initial warp spell. If you don't already have one, you also gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, which you can Refocus by contemplating infinite worlds. (For more on warp spells, see page 165.)

name: Basic Witchwarper Spellcasting
text: You gain the Basic Spellcasting benefits. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the witchwarper archetype, add a spell of the appropriate spell rank to your repertoire: a common spell of your paradox's tradition, or one of your paradox's granted spells.

name: Battle Analysis
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You roll initiative. You attempt a check to about a single creature you can sense. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Recall Knowledge check if you use the same skill you're using to roll initiative. This bonus increases to +2 if you're a master in that skill.

name: Battle Cry
text: Your call to arms invigorates allies. Once per day as a single action, grant all allies within 60 feet a +2 status bonus to attack rolls and saves against fear for 3 rounds.

name: Battle Focus
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points. You effortlessly enter a state of flow in combat. When you use Battle Focus and each time you reduce a hostile creature to 0 Hit Points in the next minute, you regain ] Hit Points equal to your level. If you're , you can reduce the wounded condition by 1 instead of regaining Hit Points.

name: Battle Medicine
text: You can patch up wounds in the heat of combat. You can use Medicine to Treat Wounds as a single action on yourself or an adjacent ally, once per target per day.

name: Battle Saint
text: You have ascended to the rank of living battle saint and are on a path to become a true divine servant of Damoritosh when you meet him in the afterlife. You can cast Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jj5d830iUi2ZlQfs and Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sX2o0HH4RjJDAZ8C as 7th-rank divine innate spells once per day each.

name: Battleblessed
text: You're an accomplished battledancer and warrior, blessed by seers, honed by ancestral tradition, and capable of feats beyond the natural abilities of your peers. You gain Tailwind as a 1st-rank primal innate spell that you can cast once per day.

name: Beam of Light
text:
Frequency once per day

You transform yourself into a beam of light and move in a straight line across a great distance. You must have line of effect and line of sight to the location, and it must be in a straight line from you, unimpeded by a barrier that would substantially block or disperse light. You transform into light, move the distance, and return to your original form at the new location. Most reactions won't work against you while you're light, unless they would affect light or a magical light effect. On a clear day on a flat plane, due to the curvature of the planet you can see about three miles. However clouds, mist, fog, and other conditions might block or disperse the light much sooner.

name: Beastie Blood
text: You have an affinity for riding animals of all shapes and sizes, and you haven't met a mount that you aren't willing to ride. You become trained in Nature. If you would automatically become trained in Nature (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the general feat and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to if the target is trained as a mount.

name: Better Split!
text: Frequency once per hour Trigger You are attacked by a foe but haven't rolled yet. In an emergency, your especially oozy body has adapted to split into multiple pieces to survive danger. A piece of you splits off to ward off a harmful blow. The triggering attacker must attempt a flat; on a success, the attack targets you normally; if they fail, the attack targets the piece of you that split off, destroying it. You become Stupefied 1 and Clumsy 1 for 1 minute, after which time your body regrows the split-off part.

name: Big Bang
text: Frequency once per hour Requirements You're photon-attuned. You manifest a fragment of the cosmic forces from the Universe's first moments, unleashing a blast of scouring cosmic fire that reverts all things to their basic components and overcomes even magical defenses. This deals (max((@actor.level - 4),10))d6[fire|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in a type:emanation|distance:30. You and any number of adjacent allies are unaffected by this Big Bang. Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and 4d6[persistent,fire|options:photon-attuned] damage, and you can attempt to counteract a spell on the creature, using half your level, rounded up, as the counteract rank. Level (+1) Increase the damage by 1d6.

name: Big Mouth
text: Your cheek pouches are especially large and stretchy. Instead of storing up to four items of light Bulk in your cheek pouches, you can store up to 1 Bulk worth of items. The maximum size of a given item is unchanged.

name: Binaric Assault
text: You coordinate your attacks with both your solar flare and solar weapon. Make two Strikes at the same target, one with your solar weapon and one with your solar flare, each using your current multiple attack penalty. You can make these Strikes in whichever order you desire. After the first time a Strike hits, resolve the damage and effects, then swap your current attunement. If both attacks fail to hit, you become unattuned. Binaric Assault counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty.

If both attacks fail to hit, you become unattuned. Binaric Assault counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty.

name: Bioaugment Slot
text: Your living frame can house more augmentations than others. You can install one additional augmentation in any single body slot.

name: Bioluminescence
text: Your eyes glow like bioluminescent lamps, and you have learned how to focus them into a directional beam. Your eyes shed light in a 30 foot line in any direction you're looking. You can suppress or restore this light as a free action. In addition, while this light is active you can take the Point Out action to indicate a creature within the area of your bioluminescence without making any noise, in which case it loses the auditory and manipulate traits. Finally, after you use an action to Hide or Sneak, you can send predetermined signals with your lights to alert all allies you can see to your location as a free action.

You can suppress or restore this light as a free action. In addition, while this light is active you can take the Point Out action to indicate a creature within the area of your bioluminescence without making any noise, in which case it loses the auditory and manipulate traits. Finally, after you use an action to Hide or Sneak, you can send predetermined signals with your lights to alert all allies you can see to your location as a free action.

name: Bioluminescence (Shirren)
text: You can induce a chemical reaction that allows a part of your body to glow. You must designate what part of your body glows when you take this feat. You begin to glow with bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for the next 20 feet. While you're glowing, you can't be and you take a –4 penalty to Stealth checks to [[/act hide]] and [[/act sneak]]. You can Dismiss the glow as a free action. At 9th level, you shed bright light in a 40-foot radius and dim light for the next 40 feet.

name: Bioluminescent Flash Bang
text: Frequency once per day The chemical reaction in your body has grown more potent with time. You release a blinding burst of bioluminescence. Creatures in a around you must attempt a Fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. On a failure, the creature becomes Dazzled for 1d4 rounds. On a critical failure, the creature is also Blinded for 1 round.

text: You gain the Biometric Assessor mod (weapon): when the modded weapon deals damage to a creature, you can Recall Knowledge about it as a free action with a +1 circumstance bonus, rolling as if trained even if you're untrained.

name: Bionanite Skin
text: You can tap into your biotech's generative nature to don a new face or persona and better adapt to your surroundings. You physically modify your features to another creature of the same size category as yourself. Using Bionanite Skin counts as creating a disguise for the Impersonate use of Deception, and you gain a +2 status bonus to checks to Impersonate to pretend you're this other creature. You remain in this shape indefinitely and can shift into another shape by using this action again.

name: Biowaste Schmiowaste
text: Where others see garbage and slime, you see bandages and disinfectants. Your become an expert in Medicine. You gain the skill feat, and you can apply its benefit to [[/act treat-disease]] and [[/act treat-poison]] actions in addition to .

name: Biting Corpsefolk
text:
A transformation after death twisted your body, elongating your teeth into fangs or sharpening your appendages into claws. When you select this feat, you gain one of the following unarmed attacks of your choice: claw or jaws. Both of these attacks are in the brawling weapon group and have the listed damage die and traits.

Claw 1d6 slashing (agile, finesse, unarmed)

Jaws 1d6 piercing (grapple, unarmed)

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these attacks, you get its critical specialization effect.

name: Bizarre Magic
text: You can draw upon strange variations in your spellcasting, whether or not you can cast occult spells. The DCs to Recognize Spells you cast and Identify Magic you use increase by 5.

name: Black Hole
text: While in graviton mode, you create a gravitational pull. Spend your full attunement to attempt to pull all creatures within 20 feet 10 feet closer to you (Athletics vs. your class DC to resist).

name: Blazing Corona
text: Your ability to manipulate solar radiation has improved. You can manifest your wings to use Coronal Flare without any hands at any time, even if you are not in a vacuum. In addition, your Coronal Flare gains the Thrown 40 feet trait.

name: Blend In
text: You know how to blend in and become a forgettable face in the crowd. While in a crowd of at least 10 other creatures, you can roll a Society check in place of a Stealth check when using the Avoid Notice exploration activity to see if enemies notice you. While in a settlement, you can use Society in place of Deception when Impersonating a non-specific individual.

name: Blinding Awe
text: Trigger You're about to [[/act demoralize]] with the visual trait while you're in an area of bright light. You focus your mantle's reflective properties to overwhelm not just your target's will but also its senses. Attempt your intimidation check against the target's Reflex DC instead of its Will DC. If you critically succeed, the target is Dazzled until it's no longer frightened.

name: Blood Born
text: Your magical blood resists being spilled. Your DC on flat checks to end persistent bleed damage is reduced from 15 to 10, or from 10 to 5 after receiving especially appropriate assistance.

text:
Frequency once per day

By tapping into the latent necromantic energies that surround you, you leech vitality from nearby living creatures, healing your own body in the process. You cast Vampiric Exsanguination as a 7th-rank divine innate spell, but the spell affects only the target of your last Strike.

name: Blood Sense

This means you can use your sense of smell to determine the exact location of a living creature who isn't at its full Hit Points. Creatures that don't have blood, such as oozes and most constructs, can't be detected with your blood sense.

name: Blood-Tinged Attack

The first time you successfully Strike a creature before the end of your turn, your target becomes tinged with your blood for the next minute. Double the range of any of your spells that target any creature tinged with your blood. In addition, you don't need line of sight to target them with spells, though you still need line of effect. Special Blood-tinged Attack is a free action if you're taking persistent bleed damage.

name: Bloody Wounds

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Will saving throws and Will DCs against mental effects and effects created by fey, and once per day, you can roll twice and take the better on a save against a mental effect or an effect created by a fey.

name: Blossoming Technology
text: You can activate the energy within technology and spur it into new, blossoming life. You can cast Verdant Code as a 2nd-rank primal innate spell once per hour.

name: Blue Mood

When things seem about to turn against you or your allies, you invoke your innate connection to the fickle and uncanny whims of luck. The triggering check can be rerolled, and the second result must be used.

name: Body Art

This augmentation doesn't count against the maximum number of augmentations you can implant, and each time you gain a new ancestry feat, you can upgrade this augmentation to a new augmentation of your level or lower at no cost, representing your continued exploration in body modification.

text: You overexert your internal hydraulics for a burst of speed. You Stride with a +10-foot circumstance bonus to your Speed. When your movement ends, you become until the end of your next turn. You can't use this feat while suppressed.

text: Frequency once per hour Trigger You fail an Athletics check to Disarm, Grapple, Reposition, Shove, or Trip. You draw on your inner reserves and rally yourself to try again. Reroll the triggering check, but you must use the new result, even if it's worse.

You draw on your inner reserves and rally yourself to try again. Reroll the triggering check, but you must use the new result, even if it's worse.

name: Bursting Surge
text: You don't just hum with dim light, you exude a burst of it. When you use Nanite Surge, you can choose to have your circuitry exude bright light in a and dim light 10 feet beyond that for 1 round. Creatures that start their turn in the area of your bright light must attempt a reflex save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. On a failure, a creature is Dazzled for 1 round (or Blinded for 1 round and dazzled for 1 minute on a critical failure). A creature can spend a single Interact action to rub its eyes to remove the blinded condition.

name: Byzantine Linguistics
text:
You've spent hours poring over dusty tombs and ancient inscriptions, giving you practiced insight into linguistic problems. You gain access to uncommon languages that are restricted due to belonging to ancient civilizations or long-lost cultures. This does not give you access to languages that are restricted for additional reasons, such as not being decoded yet or being a secret language.

You can use Society or Delve Lore to Decipher Writing and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus on checks made to decipher text in a language that you don't know.

name: Cable Slicer
text: You're a quick study when it comes to breaking things, even with minimal equipment. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Computers and Crafting checks to if the device has the tech trait. Additionally, while wielding a weapon from the knife group, you can treat it as an Infiltrator's Toolkit when attempting to Disable a Device or .

name: Calcifying Enzymes
text: Your resin contains a protective hardening reagent activated by stress. Whenever you're , , or , you gain resistance equal to the value of the condition against physical damage. This doesn't apply to conditions caused by beneficial effects, such as the enlarge spell.

name: Call Forth Gravity
text: Gravitational forces are always accessible to you, even in a vacuum. You can cast as a 3rd-rank occult innate spell once per day. The first time each day that you cast this spell while in a vacuum, that casting doesn't count toward this limit.

name: Call the Hive
text: When you're stumped, you can reach out through your hive mind to access the shared knowledge of your colony. Once per day, when you attempt to Recall Knowledge with a skill you aren't trained in, you can treat your level as your proficiency bonus. Additionally, you can roll twice on the check and take the better result. Special If you have the Hypertelepathy feat, you can use the skill modifier of a willing ally within range of your telepathy even if it's a skill you aren't trained in.

name: Called Fire
text: You coordinate ranged attacks with surgical precision. As a 2-action activity, designate a square you can see. Until your next turn, allies who attack creatures in that square gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls.

name: Called Shot
text: Before making a ranged Strike, declare a body part to target. On a critical hit, apply an additional effect: limb (clumsy 1 for 1 minute), head (stunned 1), torso (slowed 1 for 1 round).

name: Called to Another World
text: The Call led you far away to another planet. You gain the Adopted Ancestry general feat, and you also gain one 1st-level ancestry feat from the ancestry you chose for the Adopted Ancestry feat or the Unconventional Weapon standardized ancestry feat.

name: Called to Artistry
text: When you first heard the Call, you began to truly understand the meaning of beauty. Once per day, when you fail a Crafting check, Performance check, or a Lore check related to art or crafting, you can reroll the check and take the higher result.

name: Called to Help
text: The Call led you to help others, whether members of your ancestral colony or friends you've made after years of swashbuckling adventures. At the start of your turn, you gain one additional reaction, which you can use only to Aid.

name: Called to War
text: The Call led you to war, whether on Castrovel or another world. When wielding a weapon you aren't proficient with, treat your level as your proficiency bonus. At 11th level, you become trained in all weapons.

name: Calm Before the Storm
text: You maintain a calm demeanor even when facing mortal peril. When frightened, at the end of your turn, reduce your frightened condition by 2 instead of 1.

name: Camera Blur
text:
Frequency once per hour
With focus, you remove yourself from videos and pictures, leaving only pixelated images and static behind. You become Concealed to all technological visual sensors, such as security cameras, ocular cybernetic augmentations, and the visual processors of technological constructs, for 1 minute.

name: Camouflage
text: You are able to camouflage into natural environments with ease, as your scales shift to match the coloration and pattern of the area around you. You can Hide in natural environments even without cover or concealment, and you don't become automatically observed in a natural environment if you end your Sneak without cover or concealment.

name: Camouflage Expert
text: You use your camouflaged skin to your advantage, moving unseen with ease. When you use Shifthide Camouflage and are in your selected terrain, you can [[/act hide]] or [[/act sneak]] without cover or being Concealed.

name: Camouvisage
text: You shift the color and texture of your skin to match your surroundings. You Change Shape, but instead of taking on the form of another creature, you blend in with your environment. As long as an observer is at least 20 feet away from you, you don't need cover from that observer to Hide or Sneak. This lasts as long as you stay in your new form or until you move to an area with substantially different terrain.

name: Cannonball
text: Years of playing skitterspree trained you for a special move. You curl up into a tightly wound ball, and an adjacent ally with a free hand that's at least one size larger than you can use a reaction to attempt a ranged Strike with your body as an unarmed attack that deals ] damage for the duration of the Strike. This unarmed attack is in the brawling weapon group and has the agile, analog, brutal, and thrown (20 feet) traits. This unarmed attack gains the benefits of your worn hardlight handwraps . You land adjacent to the target, but you land Prone if the Strike is a critical failure.

name: Canny Acumen
text: Your avoidance or observation is beyond the ken of most in your profession. Choose Fortitude saves, Reflex saves, Will saves, or Perception. You become an expert in your choice. At 17th level, you become a master in your choice.

name: Canny Survivor
text: Your survival instincts are honed by a life of danger and scarcity, and you've learned to never let your guard down. You are not Off-Guard against Hidden or undetected creatures. In addition, you can use Survivor's Instincts anytime you would attempt a Reflex save.

name: Cantrip Expansion
text: Dedicated study lets you prepare a wider range of simple spells. You can prepare two additional cantrips each day.

name: Cantrip Expansion
text: Study broadens your range of simple spells. Add two additional cantrips from your spell list to your repertoire.

name: Cantrip Expansion
text: Study broadens your range of simple spells. Add two additional cantrips from your spell list to your repertoire.

name: Cantrip Expansion (Starfinder)
text: Study broadens your range of simple spells. Add two additional cantrips from your spell list to your repertoire.

name: Capsize
text: You try to capsize an adjacent aquatic vessel of your size or smaller. To do so, you must succeed at a Athletics check check (reduce the DC by 5 for each size smaller the vessel is than you are) or the pilot's Sailing Lore DC, whichever is higher.

name: Capture Laser
text: Light is nourishment for you, even if it comes in the form of highly concentrated beams. You gain resistance 5 against laser weapons and effects with the light trait. You can also use the Photon Accelerator activity.

name: Careful Strike
text: You focus on your solar weapon's trajectory so you can adjust it up to the last possible moment and turn a missed attack into a glancing blow. Make a Strike with your solar flare or solar weapon. It gains the following failure effect. Failure Your attack deals damage equal to your Strength modifier. It doesn't count as a hit and doesn't trigger any other special abilities.

name: Careful Strike
text:
You focus on your solar weapon's trajectory so you can adjust it up to the last possible moment and turn a missed attack into a glancing blow. Make a Strike with your solar flare or solar weapon. It gains the following failure effect.

Failure Your attack deals damage equal to your Strength modifier. It doesn't count as a hit and doesn't trigger any other special abilities.

name: Carrion Feeder
text: Once per day as an Interact action, you can siphon nutrients from a dead creature. You consume part of a creature that hasn't been dead for more than 24 hours, and you heal 3d8 Hit Points, plus 1d8 for every 2 of your levels beyond 5th ((ceil(@actor.level/2)d8)[healing]).

name: Carry Their Memories
text: You have spent more of your life away from elven communities than you have within them and have grown accustomed to living surrounded by other species. You've buried more non-elven friends than most elves will make across their entire lifetimes, and you will carry the memories of these friends for centuries. During your daily preparations, you can reminisce about a lost friend, gaining the skill feat for one skill you're trained in. This lasts until you prepare again. Since this skill feat is temporary, you can't use it to satisfy a prerequisite for a permanent character option.

name: Casting Expertise
text: Your mastery of spellcasting improves. Increase your spell attack bonus by 1 and increase the save DC of your spells by 1.

name: Cat Fall
text: Your catlike agility allows you to cushion your fall. Treat any fall as 10 feet shorter for the purpose of calculating fall damage.

name: Caterwaul Concertina
text: Frequency once per day By preparing your caterwaul, you can focus on your performance and sing to a wider audience. If your next action is to use Pahtra Caterwaul, you can affect up to five targets instead of one. If any allies in range of your caterwaul speak Pahtra, they can spend their reaction to join in on your Pahtra Caterwaul. If at least one ally joins the Pahtra Caterwaul, increase the frightened value of targets that fail their save by 1.

name: Caterwaul Strut
text: You can sashay while you sing. You Stride. You can use Pahtra Caterwaul at any point during the Stride. If you're more than 5 feet above the target of this Pahtra Caterwaul, the range of the Pahtra Caterwaul increases by 30 feet.

name: Caustic Biotoxins
text: Your body excretes abrasive chemicals in your slime when you're threatened. When you use Slime Squirt or Slime Spray, creatures in the area take ] damage with a basic reflex saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. At 12th level and every three levels thereafter, the persistent acid damage increases by 1d4.

name: Caustic Trail
text: Frequency once per day A mixture of resin and corrosive slime oozes from you and trails behind you as you move. You Climb or Stride twice. You leave a trail of slime in each square you leave as part of this movement, and each square adjacent to those squares, except the square where you end your movement. Each square containing slime becomes difficult terrain as well as hazardous terrain, dealing ] damage for each square a creature moves through. The slime dries out, ending these effects, after 1 minute. At 17th level, the hazardous terrain deals ] damage.

name: Cautious Cast
text: You study your spellcasting carefully to avoid errors. You can take 10 on Arcana checks even when threatened or distracted, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to concentrate on spells.

name: Cautious Curiosity
text: You've met all kinds of people in your long and varied life and have steeled your mind with caution. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against mental effects and a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to .

name: Cautious Trespasser
text: You grew up in a dangerous environment that taught you to be wary. You can perform the Investigate exploration activity at the same time as the Search exploration activity.

name: Cave Legs
text: Scrambling through tunnels beneath the rocky surface of Nchak can be difficult when you're a 12-foot-tall arthropod with thick, armored plates covering most of your body, but they say practice makes perfect. You've spent enough time squeezing yourself through tunnels that your exoskeleton has grown accustomed to bending and deforming to fit in tight spaces, and by now, it hardly slows you down at all. You become trained in Acrobatics. If you would automatically become trained in Acrobatics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the Quick Squeeze feat.

name: Celebratory Cheer
text:
Frequency once per minute

Trigger An ally within 30 feet critically hits a foe.

You celebrate your ally's incredible success with a heady rush of contagious ardor. You gain a +1 status bonus on attack rolls against the foe that your ally critically hit for 2 rounds. If you critically hit the foe while you have the bonus, the ally who triggered your Celebratory Cheer can use their reaction to gain a +1 status bonus on attack rolls against that foe for 2 rounds.

Effect: Celebratory Cheer

name: Cellular Acceleration
text: Frequency once per day You speed up your body's metabolism and respiration by changing yourself at a cellular level. You become Quickened for 1 minute and can use the extra action each round only for Strike and Stride actions.

name: Cellular Adaptation
text: The malleable nature of your body dulls the impact of physical ailments. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases, poisons, and radiation. If you roll a success on a saving throw against one of these effects, you get a critical success instead.

name: Cellular Regeneration
text: Frequency once per day Your body can repair damaged cells and even regrow missing limbs. You gain regeneration equal to half your level for 1 minute. During this time, you can't die from damage and your dying condition can't increase to a value that would kill you, though if your wounded value becomes 4 or higher, you stay Unconscious until your wounds are treated. Each time you regain Hit Points from regeneration, you also regrow one damaged or ruined organ (if any), and you can reattach severed body parts by spending an Interact action to hold the body part to the area it was severed from.

name: Cellular Static Discharge
text: Frequency once per hour Your body stores cellular kinetic energy as a static charge. You discharge this electricity in a (15 feet if you're in a body of water). All creatures in the area take |options:area-damage] damage (basic Reflex save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC). On a critical failure, a creature becomes Immobilized for 1 round. At 13th level, the damage increases to 8d6. At 17th level, the damage increases to 11d6.

name: Center Thoughts
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You fail a Will saving throw against a mental effect. You center your thoughts and focus your mind, shaking off emotional turmoil and harmful mental intrusions. Reroll the triggering saving throw and use the better result.

name: Center Your Emotions
text: Frequency once every 10 minutes You pause and take a quick breath to stabilize your emotions. Choose any emotional state for your soulfeel. Special You can Center Your Emotions as a free action if you're a Court of Dance Moyishuu who chooses joy, a Court of Fields Moyishuu who chooses wonder, a Court of Flames Moyishuu who chooses fury, or a Court of Song Moyishuu who chooses sorrow.

name: Centered Mind
text: You know your own mind and instinctively resist attempts to unbalance your thoughts or control your emotions. You can use Center Thoughts once per hour, rather than once per day.

name: Centering Scent
text: You can recenter yourself with a familiar scent stored on your body, such as a favorite food, the scarf of a loved one, or a sample of dirt from your home world. Roll a flat. Critical Success Reduce your Frightened value by 2. Success Reduce your frightened value by 1.

name: Cerebral Circumvention
text: Trigger A Telepredicted creature uses an effect that requires a Reflex save or attempts to Disarm or Trip you. Requirements You have a bonus against the target using Telepredict. By reading cues and analyzing probability outcomes, you smoothly predicting your opponent's next move. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Reflex save or Reflex DC against the triggering action. Increase this bonus to +2 if you've dealt mental damage to the target since the last time you used Telepredict.

name: Change of Plans
text: Trigger The target of your Get 'Em! is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Requirements You used Get 'Em! against a creature on your last turn. When the target you directed your allies to take down falls Unconscious or is destroyed, you quickly direct them at another target. You use Get 'Em! against a new target following all the normal targeting restrictions for Get 'Em! You don't count as leading by example against this new target.

name: Change of Plans
text:
Trigger The target of your is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

Requirements You used Get 'Em! against a creature on your last turn.

When the target you directed your allies to take down falls or is destroyed, you quickly direct them at another target. You use Get 'Em! against a new target following all the normal targeting restrictions for Get 'Em! You don't count as leading by example against this new target.

name: Change Shape
text:
You can take a humanoid guise, hiding your draconic majesty behind a more innocuous form. Your humanoid form is a specific form of a common Small or Medium humanoid ancestry prevalent where you grew up (typically human). This form is distinctive and unique, and you change into the same form each time. In your humanoid form, you might possess a distinguishing characteristic that hints at what type of dragon you are, such as startling emerald eyes or a streak of copper in your hair, or there might be nothing to distinguish you from other humanoids of the same ancestry. Using Change Shape counts as creating a disguise for the Impersonate use of Deception, though only to adopt your alternate form. You lose any unarmed Strikes you gained from being a dragon in this form and gain a fist Strike instead. You can't use other abilities that require a part of your body that you don't have in humanoid form; for example, you couldn't use a feat that uses your wings if you don't have wings. As normal, if you gain any reach dependent on increased size, such as from Empowered Mass or Empowered Size, you lose that reach in your alternate form. You can remain in your alternate form indefinitely, and you can shift back to your true dragon form by using this action again.

Special Some aeternal dragons have developed the power to change into an alternate form in addition to their other abilities at the expense of their night vision. You can choose to gain Change Shape as an ancestry benefit without taking this feat in exchange for having low-light vision instead of darkvision. If you make this choice, you can't retrain Change Shape later, but you can regain darkvision by spending a 1st-level feat.

name: Channel Scales
text: You channel powerful magic into your scales, increasing their power further as your scales thicken. Your scales' item bonus to AC increases to +3, and the Dex cap changes to +2. You keep any runes inscribed in your scales, and they now modify the scales' new statistics, and your scales can continue to use your unarmored defense proficiency if it is better.

name: Channel the World's Core
text: Frequency once per day Many talphi philosophers have studied the forces underlying the universe for countless generations, finding ways to link their minds to primordial forces much like solarians. You can steady your body and mind to attune yourself to the ultradense core of your home planet, channeling the pressure and density of its core through your weapon. Add 1d4 bludgeoning damage per weapon damage die to the next attack you make with your weapon before the end of your next turn. On a critical hit, roll these damage die after doubling the weapon's damage.

name: Channel Wings
text: You channel your growing magical power into your wings, restoring full flight capacity for a time. The fly Speed you gain from Empower Wings increases to 25 feet.

name: Charged Blood
text: Frequency once per day You invoke your arcane blood so that it can revitalize and energize your body. You regain ] Hit Points. You also gain the Quickened condition until the end of your next turn and can use the extra action to only Stride or Strike.

name: Charming Liar
text: Your lies improve others' opinions of you. When you critically succeed at a Lie, the target's attitude toward you improves by one step (to a maximum of helpful).

name: Chattermander
text: You never let the inability to communicate stop you from chatting with nufriends! You gain Speak With Animals as a 2nd-rank primal innate spell, and Speak With Plants and translate as 3rd-rank primal innate spells. You can cast each of these primal innate spells once per day.

name: Check it Out!
text: You've poured all your creativity into making your weapon truly eye-catching. Choose one weapon you own to decorate in your own style. While wielding your chosen weapon, add the weapon's tracking value as an item bonus to Deception checks to Feint and Intimidation checks to Demoralize. You can only have one such weapon active at a time. You can spend 24 hours customizing a new weapon, at which point your connection with your previous weapon is lost.

name: Cheek Holster
text: You know the best place to keep a firearm is out of sight, and you've adjusted your cheeks for maximum efficiency. It takes 10 minutes to safely prepare a one-handed gun and store it in your cheek pouch, and the gun can be up to 1 Bulk. As a single action, you can Interact to draw and Strike with the gun you stored in your mouth. Special If you have the Big Mouth ysoki feat, you can store a two-handed gun instead of a one-handed gun, and the gun you store can be up to 2 Bulk instead of the normal amount.

name: Cheek Pouches
text: You make excellent use of your cheek pouches. You can store up to 1 bulk of items in your cheeks and retrieve them as a free action. Items stored this way cannot be detected without a thorough search.

name: Cheer Up
text: You encourage an adjacent ally to overcome their minor ailments by patting them on the back, providing them useful advice, or offering some form of comfort or inspiration. The target reduces the value of one of the following conditions of their choice by 2: Clumsy, Enfeebled, Frightened, Sickened, Stupefied. The target then becomes temporarily immune to Cheer Up for 1 day.
